scripts.build: cd vscode-sqldoc && node build.mjs && cd .. && bash scripts/build-binary.sh
scripts.check:licenses: pnpm licenses list --prod --json | node -e "const d=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('/dev/stdin','utf8'));const bad=Object.keys(d).filter(l=>/GPL|AGPL|EUPL|SSPL|BSL-1|CPAL|OSL-3/i.test(l));if(bad.length){console.error('Copyleft licenses found:',bad);process.exit(1)}else console.log('All licenses OK')"
